connector.name: reach
connector.registryDescription: Documents agents read and write: share & hand off versioned markdown/HTML docs. No account.
connector.summary: Hosted at reachpad.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the las7 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> for writes or private reads (omit for open create + public reads)

env.name: REACH_WRITE_TOKEN
env.description: bearer token for create/edit/delete (optional; creation is open)

env.name: REACH_READ_TOKEN
env.description: bearer token for reading private docs

env.name: REACH_ACTOR
env.description: attribution label recorded in the ledger
